Ruling: representation; i4562 pp. 13-15, Part V, and the items of the screen. The reply's screen differs from the project's only where the interview does not ask or where the project refuses elsewhere: (1) it refuses a 2025 vehicle answering No to scveh.bonus_same even with no allowance claimed; the interview asks bonus_same only where the allowance is claimed and the project refuses a mixed class election on the claiming entry (scveh.bonus_full, scveh.bonus_forty, and asset's lines), i4562 p. 7, Election out, "You can elect, for any class of property, to not deduct any special allowance for all such property in such class" (stage14.veh.2025_mq_nobonus: bonus_same unasked, project false, reply true); (2) vehicles placed in service before 2019, which the project refuses at column (d) (scveh.too_old; stage14.veh.refuse_too_old); (3) scveh.employee_use, which the project refuses at scveh.operating_business; (4) the parent-gated items (prior_bonus, prior_smr and prior_low_use only for an earlier vehicle; used_before and bonus_excluded only with an allowance; leasing, exempt_use and qbu_low only if others use the vehicle; acquired_before_bonus_date only for a 2025 vehicle), which the reply reads directly. The reply limits the screen to owned vehicles on actual expenses; the project's screen is read only through the depreciation lines of those vehicles.
